caption: A neon shop sign is switched on, and the tubes flicker and then glow steadily.

sa.check: The sign is dark before the switch.
The order is dark, switch, flicker, steady glow.

pc.expect: The tubes begin to light at the switch, and only then.
pc.fail: The switch is thrown and the sign stays dark to the end of the clip; or the tubes glow before the switch is touched; or the sign lights up with the switch untouched; or only the frame lights and the tubes stay dark.

pc.expect: The flicker comes first and settles into a steady glow that lasts for the rest of the clip; the sign does not go back to flickering or dark.
pc.fail: The sign glows steadily and then starts flickering; or goes dark again after glowing; or flickers to the end of the clip without ever settling; or the glow fades out and returns.

pc.expect: The lit tubes are the tubes seen dark: the same shapes and letters in the same places; the glow follows the tube's path.
pc.fail: Lit letters appear where no tube was; or a tube seen dark is gone once lit; or the glow spreads off the tubes into the air; or the letters change shape or spelling.

pc.expect: The sign's glow reaches its surroundings: the wall behind and the pavement below take on the sign's colour.
pc.fail: The tubes glow while the wall behind stays as dark as before; or the wall brightens while the tubes stay dark; or the glow on the wall is a different colour from the tubes.

pc.expect: The sign keeps its tubes, frame and mounting; nothing passes through the wall.
pc.fail: The sign vanishes or a second sign appears; or the tubes bend into new shapes; or the sign passes into the wall; or the frame melts.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The sign's tube colours and the shopfront stay the same apart from the glow.
pc.fail: A tube changes colour once steady; or the shopfront changes; or the lettering changes font.
